subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage.
guide_solution: Summary A country can be developed by education. A nation is developed which is educated. The rate of illiteracy in a country determines whether it is rich or poor, developed or underdeveloped. Because the development of a country depends on education. Illiteracy is the root cause of ignorance which frustrates all development efforts of the 167 Oxford Mission Road Barisal Dear Alice I am very glad to receive your letter. You have wanted to know about our country. You know that Bangladesh is a poor country. We have a population of about 130 million people. Every year our country is frequently visited by national calamities . While this is true, we have some glaring features on which we can pride ourselves. Our people are simple and brave and are capable of facing any calamity. They are quite hospitable . As a Muslim country, most of the people of our country are Muslims. Our Bangladesh is a country of villages. It is criss-crossed by many rivers. They help our agriculture mostly. The forest areas in the Sundarbans and the largest sea-beach at the Bay of Bengal are the handiwork of Nature's beauty. We have six seasons and each season comes with its own taste and beauty. The golden fields of crops, green trees, tea gardens, murmuring streams , large meadows , the hills, the flowers with their dazzling colours, the birds with their sweet songs have made this land a place of marvels. I would request you to come to our country once and visit the tourist resorts . I will escort you to the places of historical interest and importance. So much for the present. With all the best wishes. Yours ever, Nibir
